provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exact: the state is not a stabilizer state (the moduli cos(beta) and sin(beta), cos(2 beta) = 1/sqrt3, differ)

notes: Settles chi(qubit_T) = 2 with the rank-2 witness of the same cell. Exact throughout: a stabilizer state has one modulus on its support, and the moduli cos(beta) and sin(beta), cos(2 beta) = 1/sqrt3, differ, decided in sympy. The single-copy cell carries the trivial exponent and moves nothing; it is filed so the orbit page shows chi = 2 at m = 1 as it does for S, T3, and T5.
